summary: Implemented Jupyter utilities in monai/visualize/utils.py: blend_images (overlays a 2D label map on a grayscale image, returns RGB in [0,1]) and matshow3d (grid of 3D volume slices). Both are exported from monai.visualize, documented in docs/source/visualize.rst, and covered by tests/test_visualize_utils.py. Matplotlib is imported lazily inside functions, and input validation runs before that import. Test results: the 2 validation tests pass; the 2 rendering tests are skipped because matplotlib is not in the venv, so the plotting code is unverified. tests/test_img2tensorboard.py fails at collection due to missing tensorboard, which predates this change. Nothing was committed; the venv was not modified.
